name: blockradia
description: A multichain desktop blockchain explorer with wallet relationship graphs.

scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/explorer.test.mjs tests/timeouts.test.mjs tests/overview.test.mjs tests/exchanges.test.mjs tests/tron.test.mjs tests/solana-recovery.test.mjs tests/solana-throttle.test.mjs tests/evm-access.test.mjs tests/gateway.test.mjs tests/alchemy.test.mjs tests/network-statistics.test.mjs tests/large-transfers.test.mjs tests/chart-sample.test.mjs tests/network-fees.test.mjs tests/market-data.test.mjs tests/exchange-candles.test.mjs tests/ton-threshold.test.mjs tests/wallet-address.test.mjs tests/table-filters.test.mjs tests/bitcoin-dates.test.mjs tests/archive-history.test.mjs tests/security.test.mjs
scripts.start: npm run build && npm --prefix desktop start
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm --prefix desktop run package:win
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm --prefix desktop run package:mac
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm --prefix desktop run package:linux
